prompt:
Create ONE animation cel for a 2D fighter. Use the supplied Pokemon Generation 5 Black and White animated sprite as strict identity, proportions, palette and pixel-art reference. Blastoise, stocky blue turtle Pokemon, cream segmented belly, brown shell with cream rim, two metallic water cannons above shoulders, short ears, exactly two arms and two legs.
Draw this precise pose: Deep compact low crouch, body substantially shorter, looking right. Keep the head its normal size, bend the limbs.
The character faces RIGHT in three-quarter side view throughout. Preserve the same body volume, head size, pixel scale, markings and lighting as the reference. Changes in silhouette must come from articulation. Render true coarse Nintendo DS sprite pixel art, chunky square pixels, dark pixel outline, restrained flat-color clusters, hard stair-step edges. Full body and all extremities visible. Center the complete character with ample margin. One character only. Perfect uniform chroma MAGENTA background RGB(255,0,255). No text, grid, labels, multiple panels, shadows, scenery, motion trails or attack effects. No soft painting or antialiasing. The output is an enlarged pixel sprite, retaining roughly 60-80 logical pixels of character detail. The first image is the canonical idle reference and the second, if supplied, is the original palette reference. CRITICAL: The complete silhouette must fit within the central 75 percent of the canvas. Leave at least 12 percent empty magenta margin on ALL four edges, including above raised wings and ears. Never crop any body part. The crouch must be dramatically lower than standing: belly almost touches ground, thighs spread sideways, knees deeply folded, heavy shell tilts almost horizontal, neck forward, shoulders at HALF their standing height. It is a low turtle squat, not upright standing. Keep the head its normal size relative to arms. If an attack, sweep the tail along the ground while squatting this low.
